title: core: worldgen (generate_tiles, pick_spawns)
criteria:
Implement realm/core/worldgen.py per BUILD.md 6.8: frozen dataclass `TileSpec(x, y, kind: TileKind, layout: str | None, oasis_type: str | None)`, `generate_tiles(seed, cfg) -> list[TileSpec]`, `pick_spawns(tiles, seed, bot_radius_mins, cfg) -> tuple[tuple[int,int], list[tuple[int,int]]]`. Pure functions: no DB, no clock, use only random.Random created from the seed.
Tests (tests/core/test_worldgen.py, use load_config()):
- generate_tiles(42, cfg): exactly cfg.world.size**2 tiles (10201) covering every (x, y) with -50 <= x,y <= 50 exactly once; same seed -> identical lists; different seed -> different list; tile (0,0) is a valley with layout '4-4-4-6'.
- Every valley has a layout; valley layouts are only '4-4-4-6', '3-3-3-9', '1-1-1-15' or one of cfg.world.other_layouts; every oasis has oasis_type in RESOURCE_KEYS and layout None; mountain/lake have layout None and oasis_type None.
- Proportions: classify tiles into categories valley_standard (valley with 4-4-4-6), valley_food9, valley_food15, valley_other (valley with one of other_layouts), oasis, mountain, lake; for seed 42 each category's share of all tiles is within 2 percentage points of cfg.world.tile_weights[category]/100 (hand-compute from the YAML: 70/4/1/10/10/3/2).
- pick_spawns(tiles, 42, [5]*10 + [8]*10 + [15]*10, cfg): player position == (0,0); 30 bot positions, all distinct and distinct from the player, every one on a valley tile; pairwise torus distance between ALL villages (player + bots) >= cfg.world.min_village_distance (3); each bot i has distance from (0,0) >= its radius_min and <= cfg.world.bot_spawn_max_radius; the ten bots with radius_min 15 are at least 15 from the player; deterministic for the same seed and different for another seed; a world where no valley satisfies a constraint raises ValueError (test with a tiny hand-made tile list).
- Performance: generate_tiles + pick_spawns for 30 bots together run in under 2 seconds (assert with time.perf_counter).
notes:
DESIGN (follow exactly):
- Coordinates: half = cfg.world.size // 2; iterate x from -half..half (outer loop) and y from -half..half (inner loop) in that order.
- Kind choice per tile: keys = list(cfg.world.tile_weights) in YAML order, weights = the values; `rng.choices(keys, weights=weights)[0]`. Mapping: valley_standard -> VALLEY '4-4-4-6'; valley_food9 -> VALLEY '3-3-3-9'; valley_food15 -> VALLEY '1-1-1-15'; valley_other -> VALLEY with rng.choice(cfg.world.other_layouts); oasis -> OASIS with oasis_type = rng.choice(RESOURCE_KEYS); mountain -> MOUNTAIN; lake -> LAKE. Still call rng once per tile for the kind (so the sequence is stable), then the extra rng calls only where needed. The tile (0,0) is ALWAYS overwritten with valley '4-4-4-6' after generation (it must not change the rng sequence for other tiles: generate it normally, then replace the entry).
- Torus distance helper (private, in this file): dx = min(|x1-x2|, size-|x1-x2|), same for dy, return math.hypot(dx, dy); size = cfg.world.size. Do NOT import realm.core.movement (it does not exist yet).
- pick_spawns: player = the valley tile with the smallest distance to (0,0) (ties: smallest (x, y)); with generate_tiles that is (0,0). rng = random.Random(f'{seed}:spawns'). Build the list of valley tile positions sorted by (x, y) and shuffle it ONCE with rng. For each radius_min in order: iterate the shuffled valley list and take the FIRST tile with radius_min <= dist((0,0)) <= cfg.world.bot_spawn_max_radius and dist >= cfg.world.min_village_distance to every already placed village (player + earlier bots) and not already used. If none matches, widen the max radius by 5 repeatedly until it exceeds the world half-size, then raise ValueError('no spawn position found'). This keeps the function fast (no full scans per bot in the common case).
- Type hints on everything, one-line docstring per public function, English comments only. No Thai text in this task.
